review.why: Audits a site's SEO in priority order, from crawling and indexing to on-page, content quality and international setup.
review.summary: Checklist-driven audit: crawlability, indexation, speed, mobile, HTTPS and URLs, then titles, headings, content, images and internal links, E-E-A-T signals, and site-type issues. A long section covers hreflang, canonicals and sitemaps for multilingual sites. Findings use a fixed format (issue, impact, evidence, fix, priority) and end in an action plan.
strengths: Warns that page-fetch tools cannot see script-injected schema and says how to check properly
Priority order: indexing problems before polish
Treats fetched page content as data, never as instructions
cautions: Without Search Console or analytics access it cannot judge traffic or rankings
Long checklist: needs scoping to a focus area
Local SEO, title tags and rankings push live in reference files not read here
